PRISM spectral table data attribution

CIE color matching functions and illuminant tables derived from:
https://github.com/mmp/pbrt-v4/blob/master/src/pbrt/util/spectrum.cpp

pbrt is Copyright (c) 1998-2020 Matt Pharr, Wenzel Jakob, and Greg Humphreys.
PhysLight code Copyright (c) 2020, Weta Digital, Ltd.
Licensed under Apache License 2.0; see PBRT_LICENSE.txt.

The generated alexandrite table combines these data with an original artistic
absorption model and Bradford chromatic adaptation. It is not measured data
from a real alexandrite specimen.

Godot engine and dependency notices: see GODOT_LICENSES.txt.

Web UI font: Prism UI SC, a renamed subset of Noto Sans SC Regular.
Original font: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/main/Sans/SubsetOTF/SC
Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/).
Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see assets/fonts/OFL.txt in source,
or OFL.txt in the Web distribution. Font modifications are limited to subsetting
and renaming. The full upstream font is not included in this repository.
